Factories

Factories

Western Refrigeration is India’s largest commercial refrigeration equipment manufacturer.

With 4 state-of-the-art factories & a manufacturing capacity of over a million units per year, we offer a wide range of reliable & energy-efficient commercial refrigerators to our customers.

MAHARASHTRA

Shahpur Plant

In early 1997 WESTERN Refrigeration decided to setup a production facility for the manufacturing of Visi-Coolers primarily to cater to the requirement of Coca-Cola India. This plant started commercial production in August 1997 and is located 90kms north of Mumbai at Shahpur. Plant employees 150 People and First plant in India to manufacture commercial coolers with state of the art manufacturing setup and currently engaged in manufacturing of special refrigeration equipment’s for Commercial Kitchen & QSR Industry.

GUJARAT

Silvassa Plant

In mid of 1999 Western set up their second plant at Silvassa (UT of DNH & DD ).Our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility provide the solution to different beverage sector and producing wide range of refrigeration system which includes Pastry Cooler, Back bar, Ice Machines, Post Mix Dispenser and many more with a scientific approach to ensure better quality and precision. This plant having backward integrated facility for producing WOT condenser with an installed capacity of 50K per month , having advanced fully automated CED line and automated welding machines and Wire Harness 250K per month.

GUJARAT

Sanjan Plant

In 2014, another state of art plant was set up in in Sanjan. Our Sanjan Plant is the largest plant of its kind in South east Asia with Fully Automatic Paint Shop, Foaming Plant , Sheet metal processing facility, Heat exchangers & Plastic automatic cutting facility.

GUJARAT

Tadgam Plant

On July 15, 2022, Western inaugurated its largest manufacturing facility in Tadgam, Gujarat, for commercial refrigerators. Our state-of-the-art manufacturing factory epitomizes the pinnacle of modern industrial efficiency, featuring a fully automated, single-line flow process. This streamlined approach ensures optimal productivity, precision, and quality control, making our factory a benchmark in the industry. It includes advanced features like an automated paint shop, foaming plants, laser & CNC based sheet metal processing machineries, automatic conveyorized buffer storage, main assembly & Industry 4.0 technology. Currently, the plant produces a range of deep-freezers, countertop and Stainless-Steel equipment for quick service restaurant industry, as well as water coolers.
